name: The form and internal context of a system
vision_statement: The AI system has a form and its own internal context, and the hub applies to a particular system by providing adapters or declaring the system's internal APIs, databases and files.
opportunities: A system's own data, and the integrations it already governs, are a different kind of evolution from the one the parent solution measures. Declaring a system's own sources, rather than rewriting parts for it, lets any product adopt the hub.
solution_coherence: Body is the form of the system and the context that belongs to it, and it lets anyone apply the hub to their own system by declaring where the data lives and which enduring integrations the AI may use. Internal Context declares where the system's data lives and which outside tool reads it, keeps what the system knows in Card Store, and proposes the cards a folder of files needs through Cards From Files. Hands makes sure that the system's own AI tool registry, LLM platform and guardrails are accessible to the AI and used by it.
